PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya Computer Instructor Selection Process 2026
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya Computer Instructor Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is Computer Instructor. This is a contractual position offered by PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya.

faq.question: Q2. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for the Computer Instructor post?
faq.answer: Candidates need to possess a B.E/B.Tech (Computer Science), B.C.A/M.C.A/M.Sc (Computer Sc.), M.Sc (Electronics with Computer Sc. Component)/M.Sc(IT)/B.Sc (Computer Sc.), or equivalent degrees as detailed in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the walk-in interview date?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview date for the Computer Instructor post is 25 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they reach the venue on time.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for this recruitment. Both General/OBC and SC/ST categories are exempt from paying any application fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the job type for the Computer Instructor position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Computer Instructor position is Contractual. This means the employment will be on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the job location for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job location for this recruitment is Bathinda, Punjab.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies of these documents, and recent passport-size photographs to the walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is 350/KV.3/Bathinda/2026-27.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, under the 'Official Notification PDF' description.
